edges.reason: restricted modifier gates setCompleted on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner gates execution on msg.sender identity.
renounceOwnership is restricted to the owner.
transferOwnership is restricted to the owner.
renouncePauser removes msg.sender from the role.
reclaimEther sends the balance to msg.sender.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
pause restricted by onlyPauser and onlyOwner checks.
changeAdmin is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
_willFallback forbids the admin from calling fallback.
sendValue performs a low-level call forwarding all gas.
Recipient contract can re-enter during the value call.
External target can re-enter via the low-level call.
isContract validates the call target before calling.
isContract validates the new implementation address.
initialized flag controls the initializer modifier.
initializing flag controls the initializer modifier.
isTopLevelCall derives from the initializing flag.
addPauser grants a role after the pauser check.
Delegatecalled implementation code can re-enter the proxy.
diamondStorage uses the fixed slot constant.
Malicious token can re-enter during the low-level call.

safeDecreaseAllowance subtracts from the current allowance.

_burn subtracts from balance and total supply.

initialSupply is minted to the holder.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter flows directly into the low-level value call performed by sendValue.
amount parameter is the value forwarded by sendValue.
initialHolder is consumed by the initial mint inside UbxToken.initialize.
initialSupply is the minted amount in UbxToken.initialize.
owner parameter is passed to the ownership initialization in UbxToken.initialize.
pausers array is iterated to grant roles inside UbxToken.initialize.
isTopLevelCall is a local bookkeeping flag used only inside the initializer modifier.
_data is the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall in the proxy initializer.
newImplementation is the upgrade target consumed by upgradeToAndCall.
data is the calldata executed by the delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall.
success is the local return flag asserted after the delegatecall.
